os-2-16.alt: Two pairs of beakers. In the top pair, a layer of acid on water leaves the water holding free hydrogen ions (H+). In the bottom pair, a layer of base on water leaves the water holding free hydroxide ions (OH−).

os-2-17.alt: A vertical pH scale from 0 to 14. Neutral, 7, sits in the middle; values below it are acidic and values above it are basic. Common substances are placed along the scale at their pH.
